offering_description.value: Designs, builds and sells single-family homes, townhomes and condominiums, mainly to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers. Homes are built on company-acquired land using subcontracted trades, and customers can personalize them at design studios. Also offers mortgage and title services through affiliates.

primary_services.value: mortgage financing (via joint venture); title services; home design personalization

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time, move-up and active adult homebuyers

revenue_model.value: product sales: new homes and lots sold to homebuyers; service fees: mortgage and title services income from affiliates

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: acquires land, entitles and builds homes using subcontractors and purchased materials, sold to homebuyers

geography_served.value: US national: Western, Southwest, Central and Southeast states, including California, Texas, Arizona, Florida and the Carolinas

specialization.value: related lines: home building with related mortgage and title services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff at community model homes and design studios; online: website and online home search and purchase tools; agents / brokers: outside real estate brokers who bring buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: land use, zoning, environmental and building codes, mortgage lending rules such as CFPB, warranty and construction defect laws
